name: erf_7_20_1
doc: **DLMF 7.20.1.** For the normal (Gaussian) distribution with mean `m` and standard deviation `σ > 0`, the distribution f
concl: (∫ t in Set.Iio x, Real.exp (-(t - m) ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2))) / (σ * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) = erfc ((m - x) / (σ * Real.sqrt 2)) / 2 ∧ erfc ((m - x) / (σ * Real.sqrt 2)) / 2 = gaussQ ((m - x) / σ) ∧ gaussQ ((m - x) / σ) = gaussP ((x - m) / σ)
